## Tidewater 4: Review Page
`GET /webhook/tidewater/review?call=…&t=…` is the rep's page for one call: summary, what already went into the CRM, the changes that wait for an OK (with the quote behind each), BANT, objections, risks, the transcript, and the follow-up email to edit.
`POST` applies the changes the rep ticked, sends the email (Gmail live, Outbox test), logs it on the deal and closes the review. Each link has a private token, and a call can only be reviewed once.
